qa_pair.question: Across every active campaign in the deterministic evaluation fixture, inspect each campaign and its actor roster. Which campaign has the largest roster?
Explore all active campaigns and all of their actors. Considering only player characters, which actor name is alphabetically last?
Find the sole actor classified as a monster, then resolve its campaign. What is that campaign's name?
Enumerate all active campaigns and their complete actor rosters. How many actors are classified as NPCs in total?
After traversing every active campaign and its actor roster, how many campaign-bound actors exist altogether?
Compare role composition across the active campaigns. Which campaign has the same number of player characters and NPCs?
Read the detailed records for every actor and locate the summary that mentions a sealed observatory. What is that actor's name?
Resolve the roster belonging to Beta Citadel and count the distinct actor classifications represented there. What is the count?
Resolve each campaign's system identifier through the server's supported-system catalog. What display name is shared by both fixture campaigns?
Sort the active campaigns by their human-readable names, select the first, and report its canonical slug.
